description:
[About ABEMA, the Original TV, Drama, and Video Streaming Service]
ABEMA is a video streaming service aiming to innovate television and develop it as "the new future of television." No registration is required, and it broadcasts approximately 30 channels across a wide variety of genres, including a 24-hour news channel, original dramas, romance reality shows, anime, and sports, 24/7, 365 days a year.

ABEMA boasts the largest number of original episodes of any domestic video service in Japan (*1), and offers a wide selection of programs, including popular anime and dramas from Japan and abroad, as well as a variety of music and live stage performances. Enjoy content anytime, anywhere, on TV and on-demand, and watch programs on your smartphone, PC, tablet, or TV device, tailored to your lifestyle and location. (*1) As of April 2025 (based on company research).

[ABEMA TV/Movie/Anime/Drama Streaming Service Recommended for the Following People]
・I don't have time to watch TV, anime, or movies at home
・I want to watch TV, anime, or movies in my spare time
・I want to watch popular anime early
・I want to watch TV, anime, and dramas of various genres
・I don't have a TV at home, so I want to watch TV, anime, and dramas using a video streaming app
・I want to watch TV, anime, and variety shows that aren't available on terrestrial TV
・I want to binge-watch popular anime and TV shows from the past
・I want to watch lots of anime for free
・I often watch anime, dramas, and TV shows on apps
・I've been spending more time at home, so I want to watch anime, Japanese dramas, Korean dramas, and more at home
・I want to watch popular TV shows, dramas, and popular anime and movies
・I want to watch nostalgic TV shows, dramas, and anime
・I want to watch anime, dramas, movies, and other shows during my commute.
・I'm looking for a streaming app that lets me watch anime, dramas, movies, etc. on my smartphone or tablet.
・I want to make a list of anime I'm interested in and watch them on my days off.
・I don't usually watch TV, so I want to watch anime and TV shows on an app that offers a wide selection of catch-up streaming.
・I want to watch anime and variety shows that aren't broadcast on TV.
・I want to find popular anime titles through the rankings.
・I want to enjoy older anime titles that weren't available on TV at the time.
・I want to enjoy TV, anime, and movies at any time and any place.
・I want to watch TV, anime, and movies all the time.
・I missed TV, anime, and movies.
・I want to watch TV in real time, not just catch-up streaming.

[Connect to your TV and watch popular anime, dramas, and movies on a big screen]
You can enjoy ABEMA on your TV and a variety of other devices.
For more information, please see the compatible devices page below.
https://help.abema.tv/hc/ja/articles/360013743211

[Many ABEMA Original Programs]
ABEMA produces and broadcasts TV programs exclusive to ABEMA, including original dramas and romance reality shows.

The ABEMA NEWS channel also broadcasts a 24-hour news channel, including emergency alerts, as well as original news programs.

[ABEMA Official Guide]
For more detailed instructions and questions, please see the following page:
https://help.abema.tv

[Contact Us]
For bug reports and other inquiries, please contact us at the address below:
info@support.abema.tv
Privacy Policy: https://abema.tv/about/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://abema.tv/about/terms
